Subject: Scheduling: Procurement Intake — PO forms, success metrics, and escalation path

Hi Emily —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. I'd like to schedule a short procurement intake/kickoff to align on PO setup, required onboarding forms, and what success looks like for the LumenHealth integration. Goal is a 30–45 minute call to: 

- Walk through our PO/ billing flow and required invoice fields
- Confirm required procurement paperwork (W-9, vendor profile, tax docs) and the format you prefer for POs
- Align the Mutual Action Plan (timeline, owners, go/no-go criteria)
- Surface any compliance/ security gating items so we can route to Security team if needed

Proposed time slots next week (PST):
- Tue 5/18 10:00–10:45am
- Wed 5/19 11:30–12:15pm
- Thu 5/20 2:00–2:45pm

I've attached our standard vendor setup/PO form and a very short MAP draft so you can skim ahead (attached: redwood_po_setup_form.pdf, MAP_v0.2.xlsx). If you prefer, we can also push a DocuSign/ vendor form link during the call.

Please reply with the best slot and who from your team should be on the call (legal/procurement/IT as relevant). If you already have an internal procurement intake template, happy to accept that instead.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

We'll join on Google Meet; invite will include the MAP draft and a short SOC 2/ security one-pager for quick reference. Sergio will lead the PO process items and Priya will cover contract/ billing contacts.

Quick answers to your questions:
- SOC 2: we have an executive summary and a questionnaire we can share prior to the call — attaching the one-pager to the invite. If Tim wants the full report we can coordinate an NDA and a restricted view.
- PO reference: we can accept PO# on the invoice (string up to 20 chars), please include the Redwood account name (LumenHealth) and a contact email for remittances. We can also accept a client-specific PO field if you have one.

Action items before the call:
- Marissa: Send invite + MAP + SOC 2 one-pager (by EOD)
- Emily/Tim: Confirm procurement contact and any internal PO reference format (reply in this thread)
- Sergio: Prepare short checklist for invoice routing and required invoice fields

Thanks — sending invite now.

Warmly,
Marissa

> Hi Emily —
> 
> Thanks for choosing Redwood. I'd like to schedule a short procurement intake/kickoff to align on PO setup, required onboarding forms, and what success looks like for the LumenHealth integration.

Thanks all — quick note from procurement ops perspective: for the kickoff I put together a 1-page success criteria checklist and updated the MAP with owners/estimated lead times (attached MAP_v0.2.xlsx). Key success criteria I'm going to highlight on the call:

- PO arrival + validation within 5 business days of signed SOW
- Test environment access for LumenHealth engineering within 7 business days of vendor activation
- Billing contact confirmed and verified in our AR system prior to first invoice
- No open security blockers requiring platform changes before go-live; any outstanding items should have an owner and ETA

Attaching the MAP version with owners. I'll cover the invoice field expectations and the minimal vendor data required to create a vendor profile on our side.

See you Wed 5/19 11:30am PST — Meet link is in the calendar invite.
